summary: Non-Invasive Monitoring Systems, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose the entry into two promissory notes: a $200,000 note with Frost Gamma Investments Trust (an affiliate of director Dr. Phillip Frost) and a $100,000 note with Chairman/Interim CEO Jane Hsiao, both dated May 7, 2026. Each note carries an 11% interest rate payable at maturity on June 30, 2026, and is prepayable without penalty. This is a routine debt financing from related parties, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special-situation event is involved; the filing merely reports a material definitive agreement and creation of a direct financial obligation.
